name: The Bellman of Cinderholt
place: dungeon buried_town (Under Cinderholt, Ashfall Hollow, level 16-19): the end boss at the foot of the buried bell tower
_doc: When the ash came down on the first Cinderholt the bell-ringer rang until it buried him; the ash set round him into stone and he is still ringing. P1 "The Warning Bell": a bell-rope lash, the toll — a soak on a random player that needs three or everyone is hurt — and ashfall from the tower. P2 at 60% "Ashfall": ash pours down over the whole square; the only cover is the three half-buried houses (rubble you hide behind; it wears down). Pull the bell rope lever when the bell is tolling to break his cast. P3 new bar "The Last Ring": he rips the bell down and swings it — a turning sweep, a ring of falling ash, and a stack.
party: Solo: very hard — the soak needs a follower. 2-3: everyone soaks. 5: as designed.

onUse.say: You yank the bell rope out of his hands — the toll breaks off!

pull: A bell rings once, muffled, somewhere under the ash.
"The mountain is coming down! Everyone out! Everyone OUT!"
The Bellman turns. He is made of grey stone and he is still ringing.
say.death: The Bellman lets go of the rope at last. The bell rings once more by itself, and stops.
say.reset: The Bellman takes up the rope and keeps ringing.

enrage.say: The bell rings and rings and the ash will not stop falling!

toll.name: The Toll
toll.say: The bell swings back — three of you stand under it, or pull the bell rope!

onInterrupt.say: The bell clanks and falls silent.

ash_cloud.name: The Ash Comes Down
ash_cloud.say: The ash is coming down on the whole square — get behind a buried house!

bell_sweep.name: Bell Sweep
bell_sweep.say: He swings the bell round on its chain!

ash_ring.name: Falling Ash Ring
ash_ring.say: Ash falls in a ring around him — in close or far out!

last_stack.name: Under the Bell
last_stack.say: {target} is under the falling bell — all of you, stand with them!

phases.name: The Last Ring
phases.say: The Bellman tears the bell out of the tower and swings it like a flail.

do.say: The last house crumbles into the ash.
